diode_photons_and_dose.method: Smaller adjacent fresh diode current minus upper observed settled-dark level; weight by minimum of wall, source-timestamp and online-beam increments; discard >2 s gaps and first 3 s after beam-on. No missing-time, early-photon-alarm or pre-diode extrapolation.
diode_photons_and_dose.limits: A conservative sampled, model-based lower estimate, not a statistical confidence bound or a strict pointwise minimum. Assumes 6 keV, passive Si/no gain, verified nA scale, stated foil thickness/density, full footprint within 40x300 um, and local energy deposition. Uncorrected diode inefficiency/other downstream losses increase inferred photons. Averaging cannot prove sub-sample minima; electron escape and footprint uncertainties are not quantified.
